# On and off by default — the `security-python` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#security-python).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — a security pack is chosen, not detected.
- **Rules:** 66 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 61 off in an opt-in preset, 5 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `sec-py/recommended` | no — opt in | 57 | 57 error | high-confidence security rules for Python, at error |
| `sec-py/strict` | no — opt in | 61 | 57 error, 4 warn | sec-py/recommended and the heuristic security rules, at warn |

## Rules

`on` runs in a fresh install; a `preview` rule runs only with `preview = true` ([SR-RULE-PACKS](../../../records/0101_rule-packs.md) decision 9). † a preset `init` writes only when the repo has what it is for.
